summary: Hand-authored TI compliance lanes: anonymous product-page JSON-LD parsing + blanket statement PDFs, and cookie-injected Browserbase access to Environmental Ratings and IPC-1752A Class-D FMD XML.
reason: TI's compliance data is not a REST API; the anonymous facts live in server-rendered JSON-LD and the rich data is behind a myTI login reused via a deposited Browserbase cookie snapshot. Ported from the arungk/agent tiscrape prior art.
validated_outcome: Both lanes live-proven 2026-07-23: anonymous RoHS/REACH for TUSB320RWBR/TPS53355DQPT/TPS54360BDDA; gated ratings+FMD Class-D XML via a real myTI HIL login. ValidateOPN charset gate pins the JS-injection fix.
